cases.description: Test case where the ByteState has no transitions. This should return 0 as there's no complexity.
ByteState has transitions but none lead to any wildcard patterns. The expected output should be the calculated maxSize based on transitions.
ByteState has transitions that lead to wildcard patterns. The size should exceed maxComplexity, returning maxComplexity.
ByteState has cyclic transitions. The function should handle cycles without infinite loops and return the calculated maxSize.
ByteState transitions lead to other NameStates. The function should recursively calculate complexity and return the max size from these states.

input.value: ByteState with transitions and some leading to wildcards

cases.description: ByteState has transitions where some lead to wildcard patterns but do not exceed maxComplexity. The expected output should be the calculated maxSize based on transitions.

input.value: ByteState with multiple transitions leading to different wildcard patterns

cases.description: ByteState has multiple transitions, each leading to different wildcard patterns. The function should calculate the maxSize considering all accessible wildcard patterns.

input.value: ByteState with transitions leading to cycles and wildcards

cases.description: ByteState has transitions that form cycles and also lead to wildcard patterns. The function should handle cycles and calculate maxSize considering wildcard patterns.

input.value: ByteState with transitions leading to empty byte transitions

cases.description: ByteState has transitions that lead to empty byte transitions. The function should skip these empty transitions and calculate the maxSize based on non-empty transitions.

input.value: ByteState with transitions leading to the same state

cases.description: ByteState has transitions that lead back to the same state, forming a self-loop. The function should handle self-loops and calculate the maxSize correctly.
Test case where the ByteState is null. This should throw a NullPointerException as the method attempts to access methods on the null object.
Test case where the ByteState has invalid transitions that do not conform to expected structures. This should throw an IllegalStateException due to unexpected transition handling.
Test case where ByteState's getTransitions method returns null. This should throw a NullPointerException when trying to iterate over transitions.

input.value: ByteState with transitions leading to null ByteState

cases.description: Test case where one or more transitions lead to a null ByteState, which should throw a NullPointerException when trying to access methods on the null ByteState.

input.value: ByteState with transitions leading to null SingleByteTransition

cases.description: Test case where the transition expands into a null SingleByteTransition, leading to a NullPointerException when trying to access methods on it.
